Title: How Auto Archiving Can Save Your Nintendo Switch Storage
IntroLines: Running out of storage space on your Nintendo Switch whenever you try to download new games?
In this video, I'll show you how auto-archiving automatically frees up gigabytes of space while keeping your save data completely safe.

Sections.Heading: METHOD 1: HOW AUTO-ARCHIVING WORKS AND USING QUICK ARCHIVE
Steps: •  First, from your HOME Menu, open " System Settings " from the bottom toolbar.
•  Scroll down the left sidebar and select " Data Management " .
•  On the right side, select " Quick Archive " .
•  The Switch will automatically detect and suggest games you haven't played recently.
•  Check the boxes next to any games you want to archive.
•  Select " Archive Data " on the right side of the screen.
•  Select " Archive " to confirm.
•  Notice that your game data is removed to free up space, but your save files remain 100% safe.
•  Finally, return to your HOME Menu and check your newly available storage space.
Sections.Bridge: If there are favorite games you never want the console to automatically touch, here's how to protect them.

Sections.Heading: METHOD 2: PREVENT AUTO-ARCHIVING ON YOUR FAVORITE GAMES
Steps: •  First, open " System Settings " from your HOME Menu.
•  Scroll down the left sidebar and select " Data Management " .
•  On the right side, select " Manage Software " .
•  Browse through your library and select the favorite game you want to protect.
•  Scroll down and select " Prevent Auto-Archiving " .
•  Toggle the setting to " Yes " to lock the game files onto your console.
•  Repeat this step for any other games you play regularly so the system never archives them.
•  Finally, return to your software list and verify that auto-archiving is disabled for your selected games.
Sections.Bridge: Whenever you want to jump back into an archived game, restoring it takes just one tap.

Sections.Heading: METHOD 3: INSTANTLY RESTORE AND REDOWNLOAD AUTO-ARCHIVED GAMES
Steps: •  First, scroll through your HOME Menu to find your archived game tile with the small cloud icon.
•  Select the game icon with the " A " button on your Joy-Con or controller.
•  A system prompt will appear notifying you that software data must be downloaded.
•  Select " Download " on the screen.
•  The game data will begin downloading in the background from the Nintendo eShop.
•  Don't worry, your existing save data and progress will automatically load once it finishes.
•  Finally, check your HOME Menu and launch the game as soon as the download bar completes.

OutroLines: And that's how auto-archiving can effortlessly save your storage space on your Nintendo Switch without losing your saves.
